The single helper I have (`get_current_weather`) accepts a human‑readable “City, State” or “City, Country” name and only gives today’s current conditions, not multi‑day hourly projections.

If you’d still like that information, you might try:

* **Weather APIs** – Services such as [OpenWeatherMap](https://openweathermap.org/api), [AccuWeather](https://www.accuweather.com/en/apis) or [NOAA Climate Data Online](https://www.ncdc.noaa.gov/cdo-web/) let you query by lat/lon and return full daily/hourly forecasts.
* **Websites** – Sites like Weather Underground or the National Weather Service allow you to enter coordinates directly on their maps and view extended outlooks.

Let me know if there’s anything else I can help with!
